cohort: The study included five Chinese patients (four males, one female) who presented with coarse facial features, rib protrusion, chest deformities, and scoliosis, with disease onset at six months of age (range: 0-1.5 years).
finding: Patients presented with classic symptoms of MPS VII due to b-glucuronidase deficiency, and exome sequencing identified compound heterozygous mutations in the GUSB gene, including three novel pathogenic mutations.
